examples.game-symphonic.name: Game music — symphonic
examples.game-symphonic.description: Game themes performed by the London Philharmonic Orchestra. Includes the supplied Assassin’s Creed: Revelations theme.
examples.game-symphonic.yearNote: Years refer to Spotify releases of the orchestral arrangements, not game launches. Cards also include game titles.
examples.game-originals.name: Game music — original recordings
examples.game-originals.description: Recognizable themes and songs from original game soundtracks. Classics, major series and independent games.
examples.game-originals.yearNote: Years come from soundtrack releases and may indicate a reissue. Cards also include game titles.
